_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); machinery and engines signals

pit_profile.why: 'Caterpillar is the leader in construction and mining equipment, and diesel and natural gas engines and industrial gas turbines in our size range' (FY2007 10-K, Item 1); 'Caterpillar products and product support services are sold worldwide into a variety of highly competitive markets'; 'The energy and mining industries are major users of our machines and engines. Decisions to purchase our machines and engines are dependent upon performance of these industries.' and 'The rates of infrastructure spending, housing starts, and commercial construction, play a significant role in our results.' (Item 1A): demand that depends on the industries served is not earnings that are the cycle (the RCL rule), so DURABLE; no disruption theme is live for it

classification.quality_note: 'Caterpillar is the leader in construction and mining equipment, and diesel and natural gas engines and industrial gas turbines in our size range' (FY2007 10-K, Item 1); 'Caterpillar products and product support services are sold worldwide into a variety of highly competitive markets'; 'The energy and mining industries are major users of our machines and engines. Decisions to purchase our machines and engines are dependent upon performance of these industries.' and 'The rates of infrastructure spending, housing starts, and commercial construction, play a significant role in our results.' (Item 1A): demand that depends on the industries served is not earnings that are the cycle (the RCL rule), so DURABLE; no disruption theme is live for it. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price fair; Ratio B 0.87x; +20% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap +0.34; conservative 2yr +25%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -36.0%/yr (worst year FY98-FY07, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +8.7%/yr (FY08 guide + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +11.3%/yr (FY98-FY07 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +60.9%/yr (best 2-yr run FY98-FY07); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: CAT (retrospective, 2008-04-04) ◎ ACCUMULATE — Ratio B 0.87x (64.0% downside to Bear $28 / +73.5% upside to Bull $135) | Adj composite 2.38 vs market 2.04: gap +0.34 [MODESTLY UNDERVALUED] | +20% above the EPP floor $65 (11x FY08E $5.91) | Conservative 2-yr case: +24.9% total (+12.5%/yr) | At 13.2x FY08E the 15% hurdle price $103 sits between the BASE and BULL cases; Machinery sales +13.0% in Q4 2007, forward revenues +5-10% (FY08 sales and revenues guide); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
